scene iocollapse1
It appears that tonight will be a night of collapses.
It started with me- overstaying my welcome in a welcoming place until something else came and forced my head underwater.
If it weren’t for Io’s inherent need to remain burrowed into my scales in order to function, I’d probably be a lot worse off than I am right now.
I repeatedly thank her inside of my head, doing my best to not curse her in the process as I’m often unsure of whether or not staying here is good for me after all.
We’re at a point now where I often contemplate disappearing again for the sole purpose of making everyone else’s lives easier.
Unfortunately, there are reasons for me to stay here. Which allows me to circle back to my incessant, half-hearted gratefulness and remind you that this is a night of collapses.
Uta was the next to collapse- and she’s currently tucked into the same bed I was asleep in just minutes ago. But the reason for her departure from the conscious world was a lot more cut and dry.
Unless my penis reminded her of something she’d rather not see, that is.
But based on the hue of her cheeks and the smile plastered to her face even now, I don’t think that’s the case.
Io will be the last to fall — though, it’s difficult for me to say that when she’d likely have you know she started tonight from the ground already.
She’s been trying to regain her footing since I’ve met her, and I’ve done nothing but kick her in the kneecaps as she tries to get up.
But...in a sense, she’s been kneecapping herself as well.
In looking at the pull switch with the tennis ball grip, I recount the things she's done, both right and wrong, and prop up imaginary fingers on imaginary hands in order to keep track of them.
The one with all her issues is packed before I know it- so I add even more fingers to the invisible hand.
I add...and add...and add until it’s no longer a hand at all, but a hideous abomination that only someone like her, who sees ugliness in beauty and beauty in ugliness, could ever grow to love.
Maybe that’s why she’s fallen so hard for me.
Maybe that’s one more reason she’d have you know she started off this night collapsed already.
I feel young again.
But I also feel as if I’m not meant to be here.
: Uta will be fine in a few minutes, Sensei. Just need to wait for the cock shock to wear off.
: I’m a little offended you don’t react the same way. Seeing how calm you are around it is mildly off-putting.
: Need I remind you that I’ve been doing this since before all the men disappeared? I’ve seen my fair share of penises and have built up a bit of an immunity as the days have gone by, good sir.
: Yours is totally the biggest though. So I don’t blame Uta one bit for fainting.
: I’m just going to say thank you and leave it at that so I don’t perv out on you any more than I already have tonight.
: I don’t hate the fact that you do that, you know. And I definitely don’t want it to seem like I’m trying to change you or anything.
: Sure. You just want me to change, right?
: Right. And that’s totally different from changing you myself.
: I’m sure that goes both ways though, right? Like, there’s no way you’d accept all of me the way I am now. If you did, you’d be an idiot.
: Well, you’re right about that. You have more flaws than I can fit onto one invisible, mutated hand.
: An invisible mutated what now?
: Don’t worry about it. The point is that both of us suck and that we’ll probably continue sucking for the rest of our lives.
: True that. But we can suck together and that’ll make it okay.
: It’s better to wear your flaws like decorative patches than to keep them tucked in your pockets after all.
: Because at least we know who each other really are.
: Do we?
: We know enough.
scene clearnightsky
: There’s only so much room on one jacket for...patches and stuff. And if you’ve got deep pockets, then...there’s no harm in-
: Can we do away with the clothing metaphor while I’m still freshly wounded by the outfit I was wearing just a minute ago?
: Yes, thank god. I was about to back myself into a corner and had no idea how I was going to get out of it.
: Seems par for the course nowadays. You look that way every single time you step into the classroom.
: I’m sure you have a handful of places you’d rather not be as well.
: Well...you’re definitely right about that.
: You wanna talk about it? Or you wanna ignore this part of the conversation and move onto something that makes it seem like we suck a little bit less?
: I never really want to talk about anything, to be honest. Which is extremely annoying because I keep doing just that lately.
: And the worst part is that I’m not even trying to. It’s just happening.
: Well...there’s only so much room on one jacket.
: I thought we were done with clothing metaphors?
: Me too, but I couldn’t think of anything better other than a bottle and that’s just way too cliche.
: The usage was a little different this time, though. In fact, I like this new one way more than the flaws one. There really is only so much room on one jacket, Sensei.
: You can decorate it with a million things that make it look nicer and more colorful...
: But after a while, it’ll be hard to tell what any of it means at all. All those patches will start overlapping and you’ll lose any chance you have of ever blending into the background.
: Is that still what you’re trying to do in school?
: That’s what I’m trying to do everywhere.
: And it makes trying to stand out at the same time really hard. Those two things kind of contradict one another, you see.
: We can’t have everything. No one can.
: Too many patches, not enough jacket.
scene iocollapse2
: Crap. I think I might be the next one to pass out.
: You can fall asleep if you want. I’ll stay here until...either one of you comes back to life.
: I think I can hold out for a little longer. If I fall asleep, I’ll miss out on this. And I’ll be damned if I don’t savor this shoulder for every second I can.
: I’m just glad that’s all it takes to make you happy when everyone else always seems to want more.
scene iocollapse3
: Careful. You’re about to open up. And you were just talking about how you hate that you keep doing that lately.
: That’s not what I was trying to do, Io.
: Well, what were you trying exactly? Because the untrained observer might interpret that “everyone always wants more” as a bit of narcissism or braggadocio leaking through.
: Good word.
: I don’t just show up to class because I have to, you know.
: You don’t have to show up to class at all.
: True. But I actually kind of like learning. Well, some things at least.
: Or...at least the idea of learning, I guess...You know, since you always seem more focused on flirting with all your fake girlfriends than molding our minds.
: If I were to try and mold any of your minds, I’d most likely just turn them into gross, unrecognizable lumps of clay.
: He says, completely unaware that a gross lump of clay is currently resting its weird clay head upon his shoulder.
: All I meant was that it’s...nice you’re content with just this sometimes.
: It’s...a bit of a reprieve.
scene iocollapse4
: You...
: Fuck. I’m about to ruin things.
: You don’t have to lie to me, Sensei.
: I know you abhor the person I am and the things I want...or, in some cases...don’t want.
scene iocollapse5
: I know that’s how I made it sound earlier, but-
: It wasn’t just earlier. It’s all the time.
: You’ve been trying to take things further with me for like, forever. And I’ve done nothing but shoot you down. So to hear you say you’re glad that I’m like this now is...kind of a slap in the face.
: It’s like...all that anguish I felt for not being who you want me to be was totally pointless. So just tell it to me straight instead of pretending like you’ve been okay with me this whole time.
scene iocollapse6
: Knew it. Everything is ruined. Fucking Io. You did it again.
: Nothing’s ruined, I...
: I have been pushy with you. I know that.
: But the reason for it has nothing to do with me not accepting who you are or...disliking you or anything like that. I think those parts of you are fine, just...a little confusing.
: I’m...not really good when it comes to connecting without relying on the...physical aspect of a relationship to bridge the gap between myself and...whoever else.
: I can help you build that bridge, you know. You don’t have to do it alone.
: I know. But, like I said...that’s not really an area of expertise for me.
: So I probably just tried to take the easy route and lure you into having sex with me so I could...fall back on that instead.
: Gotcha.
: I get it now.
: That’s a little different from what I thought was going on...but I’m really glad you told me since what you said is way better than you only hanging around for the, uhh...potential benefits.
: The truth is, and there’s probably no need for me to actually say this when I’ve already made it pretty obvious, but...
: I don’t really look at that kind of stuff the way everyone else does.
: I don’t think it’s necessary for a functional relationship at all.
: I think that the only reason people make such a big deal of it is because it’s portrayed in movies and TV as this huge, important concept when, in all actuality...it’s kind of repulsive.

: We’re taught when we’re younger that we’re only supposed to do that kind of stuff with people we love. Then the second we get older, it’s no longer about loving anyone at all — just “feeling good” or something.
: But what if it doesn’t feel good? What if one person’s idea of pleasure is another’s nightmare brought to life?
: The idea of letting someone inside of my body makes me so fucking sick at this point that it’s borderline impossible to even speak about sometimes.
: If you wanna get even more real, it’s taking all I have to not vomit right now.
: Then stop.
: Are you sure?...
: We were just about to reach the climax.
: Pun not intended.
: I don’t want you doing anything you’re not comfortable with...And if this is a topic that makes you feel sick, we can stay away from it.
: Thank you, Sensei...
: I get that it’s probably disheartening to hear that I’m this against sleeping with you...but that’s just something I can’t imagine myself budging on any time soon.
: I’m a special case. I should have held up a big warning sign when we first met or something. “Hi, I’m Io. Please don’t touch me.” Something like that.
: It’s just one kind of touching, though.
: That’s right. It’s just one kind of touching.
: You can hold my hand whenever you want. You can hug me whenever you want. You can even kiss me if the thought of that doesn't repulse you for some strange reason.
: Just...anything more than that is...
: I can’t do it.
: I’m sorry.
: There’s nothing to apologize for.
: There is, though.
: I get that I’m an outlier and that...given your apparent libido, I’m pretty much the worst possible match for you on a physical level.
: But I get that you have “needs” and stuff, so...
: If you were to ever make me your girlfriend, I wouldn’t be opposed to you...you know...
: Doing that kind of stuff with other people...
scene iocollapse7
: What?...
: O-Obviously not with just anyone! It would need to be someone I’m okay with! Like Uta or...
: Actually, Uta is probably the only person right now I’d be cool with. Or...maybe Yuki too.
: Basically, it would have to be someone else I could be around every day. And instead of doing sexual stuff with me, you could take care of all of that with the...other girl.
: And we’d all share our time equally and...I guess for you it would be like having two or...one and a half girlfriends since I can’t...you know...uhh...
: This sounded a lot less insane when I pitched it to Uta, I swear.
scene iocollapse8
: You pitched this to Uta already?
: Yeaaaaah...but I don’t think it went very well.
: Io...would you seriously be okay with a relationship like that? You wouldn’t feel left out at all?
scene iocollapse9
: Left out? Why would I feel left out? I already told you I don’t look at that kind of stuff the way other people do. And if it’s with someone else I love, I’d be totally okay with it.
: The big thing for me is just knowing I’m wanted and needed and...that I have someone to share all of my shitty thoughts with.
: Whatever you and the other girl do to each other would be fine so long as it doesn’t come between all of us. I’d just stay out of that part.
: But I’m sure you and I could find something to do on our own as well. Same thing with me and the girl who, again, would probably be Uta because I can’t imagine this sort of future with anyone else.
: Again, I swear it sounded less crazy when I pitched it to her. I think I’m fucking things up right now.
: No, I just...
: That’s not really...a proposal I was expecting from you given how...combative you’ve been in terms of me with literally any other girl.
: That’s because I don’t like any of those girls. But if you were to hook up with Uta, I wouldn’t really mind at all.
: In fact, I’d be happy for you guys since you’re my two favorite people and, to be honest, you both have way too much sexual energy that needs to be let out.
: I’m just not sure if Uta sees you the same way I do. If she did, I’d be 100%% down to give this a shot.
: Like sure, it might have its issues at first, but what doesn’t?

: It’s the only way the two of us could ever be together without me completely rebuilding everything I am. And I might be great at building stuff, Sensei, but that is a task so daunting that even I wouldn’t touch it.
: You really...can’t imagine a future where the two of us are together without a second girl?
scene iocollapse10
: Not one I can realistically see happening at least...
: I can’t give you what you want, Sensei.
: All I can do is hold you over.
scene black
: Nngh...what time is it?...
: What happened to me?...
: Morning, sleepyhead. You passed out after walking in on Sensei’s giant wang.
: Oh...crap.
: I was really hoping that was a dream.
: He’s...not still here is-
: Morning, Uta.
: Ah! H-Heeeeey, Sensei! Crazy meeting you here! Hahah!
: Hey, uhh...I ran here all the way from the dorms, so if it seemed like I was passing out after seeing your-
: Actually, wait. Starting over. I didn’t see anything at all! I was just really tired!
: So tired that...I’m going back to sleep! Goodnight!
: Uta, no one is going to hold it against you for-
: Don’t hold it anywhere near me! That thing was the size of my leg and it wasn’t even hard yet!
: I thought you said you didn’t see it?
: I thought I said goodnight!
Uta wakes up and...promptly goes back to sleep before Io and I can put a definitive end to our conversation.
And while the final arc of our extremely uncomfortable and alarming discussion was the one bit of salvation I had during tonight’s mandatory collapse-
It didn’t pick me up at all.
It left me wanting nothing more than to remain stuck here-
Glued to the floor-
And gazing into the deep blue eyes of a girl that I should not want, but do.
Thus one more name is added to the list of things I can not have.
And it’s distressing in ways that nothing else has been.
I decide against wasting any more thoughts on it.
I feel like doing so would just make me sick.
